title: Tiered Discernment & Standard/Golden List Governance Law

standard_list.description: Applies to routine maintenance, bug fixes, script updates, documentation updates, and minor operational scripts.

golden_list.description: Reserved strictly for major architectural breakthroughs, core system rewrites, new cryptographic primitives, or sovereign deployment releases.
required_gates: Trinity Gate 3-Agent Consensus (2-out-of-3 Ed25519/Audio SHA-256 Hashes)

invariant_rules: Rule 1: No routine or minor asset fix shall require Golden List escalation; polluting the Golden List is prohibited.
Rule 2: No release candidate shall advance to remote deployment without 100% PASS on the designated tier's verification gates.
Rule 3: All media display assets (videos/GIFs) must be physically embedded and verified prior to commit.
